bramble_wolf.blurb: Lean and grey, with burrs in its fur. Hunts in pairs.

moss_toad.blurb: Big as a barrel and twice as stubborn.

cave_bats.blurb: A squeaking cloud that dives at the softest target.

goblin_scrapper.blurb: Rusty blade, dented pot for a helmet, very high opinion of itself.

goblin_hexer.blurb: Throws hexes from the back and wraps its friends in a sickly green ward.

mine_spider.blurb: Its bite stings for a while after.

rock_crab.blurb: Shell like a cobblestone. Spells and sneaky strikes work better than brute force.

bog_wisp.blurb: A cold blue light that drifts out of reach and burns.

thornjaw.blurb: A bear grown huge on the valley's berries, with brambles tangled through its hide. Strikes twice a turn.

iron_golem.blurb: Something old the miners woke. It mends itself each turn and shrugs off blows until its ward is broken: a wizard can dispel it, or enough hits will crack it.

fights.blurb: Two wolves have been eyeing the henhouse.
Something croaks under the footbridge, and something squeaks above it.
Goblins have pitched tents by the stream. Their hexer hangs back and wards the others.
Webs across the old shaft, and things moving in them.
Shells like cobblestones, and a cold light drifting over the tide pools.
The berry-fat bear of the deep woods, with a wolf at its heel. Bring friends.
Deep in the mine, something old has woken up. Break its ward or it mends itself forever.
